book: Whitaker's Disputatio de sacra Scriptura contra Robertum Bellarminum et Thomam Stapletonum (Cambridge, 1588): front matter (ordo, dedication, preface, address to the reader), then six quaestiones, each divided into numbered chapters, closed by errata and an index.
